mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, we are seeing clear skies near the Verona Public Library with the temperature at 58 degrees and a Waxing Gibbous moon phase; tonight will cool down to an overnight low of 51 degrees with no rain expected.
City of Verona facilities will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday, and please note that refuse and recycling pickup scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday.
We have a busy lineup with Live Music at Bailey's Run today, music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and Paddy Mac's hosting their music series also tomorrow.
Regarding local activity, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash occurred in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulting in a driver being arrested for O W I.
It is a great day to grab a scoop of the Really Reese's flavor of the day at Culver's, which is currently open until 10:30 PM tonight.
